gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: We've ___ out of milk — could you get some more?
An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
